source_text: Herd effects emerge from decreased transmission of human papillomavirus (HPV), where modeling studies demonstrate that widespread male circumcision curtails HPV spread to female partners, potentially averting cervical cancer cases; for instance, in Uganda, voluntary medical male circumcision programs are projected to reduce high-risk HPV transmission, yielding population-level protection beyond individual participants. [111]
